body:
I don't think serializing is actually the intended behavior. See:

* https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/discussions/7457
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/81377

Only `VariantWriter` pairs `PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE` and `PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE`. `marshalls.cpp`, `ResourceFormatSaverBinaryInstance`, `ResourceFormatSaverTextInstance`, `Node`, `Resource`, and others do not pair them.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0f5f3bc9546b46b2029fc8896dc859697f1eab97/core/variant/variant_parser.cpp#L2159-L2161

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0f5f3bc9546b46b2029fc8896dc859697f1eab97/core/io/marshalls.cpp#L1677-L1680

As far as I understand, this flag is intended to distinguish script variables from native ones or those added via `_get_property_list()`. I found the following uses of `PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0f5f3bc9546b46b2029fc8896dc859697f1eab97/editor/editor_inspector.cpp#L3113-L3117

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0f5f3bc9546b46b2029fc8896dc859697f1eab97/editor/property_selector.cpp#L134-L136

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0f5f3bc9546b46b2029fc8896dc859697f1eab97/modules/gltf/editor/editor_scene_exporter_gltf_settings.cpp#L33

```suggestion
			The property is a script variable. [constant PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE] can be used to distinguish between exported script variables from built-in variables (which don't have this usage flag). By default, [constant PROPERTY_USAGE_SCRIPT_VARIABLE] is [b]not[/b] applied to variables that are created by overriding [method Object._get_property_list] in a script.
```
